"""Probe check-jsonschema's -o json -v answer on a failing and a passing batch."""
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMAS = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-64/template/governance/kernel/schemas")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    d = Path(tmp)
    (d / "a.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id": "DAEO-abcd", "type": "task", "status": "open",
                                          "state_class": "NOPE", "deps": ["x"]}))
    (d / "b.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id": "DAEO-abcd"}))
    (d / "c.json").write_text('{"x":1')
    for files, schema in (([d / "a.json", d / "b.json", d / "c.json"], "ticket.schema.json"),
                          ([d / "b.json"], "common.schema.json")):
        r = subprocess.run(["check-jsonschema", "-o", "json", "-v", "--schemafile", str(SCHEMAS / schema),
                            *map(str, files)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print("exit", r.returncode)
        print(r.stdout[:3000])
        print("stderr", r.stderr[:500])
    (d / "bad.schema.json").write_text("{not json")
    r = subprocess.run(["check-jsonschema", "-o", "json", "-v", "--schemafile", str(d / "bad.schema.json"),
                        str(d / "b.json")], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("bad schema exit", r.returncode, r.stdout[:500], r.stderr[:500])
